Package com.smartlostfound.storage

Class CsvUserStorageService

java.lang.Object
com.smartlostfound.storage.CsvUserStorageService
All Implemented Interfaces:
UserStorageService
public class CsvUserStorageService extends Object implements UserStorageService
RFC-4180 compliant CSV persistence service for user accounts. Safely serializes credentials, contact details, and roles to disk.
